card.name: Space before a number after 'of'
card.fires_on: The blank space just before a number, most strongly after 'of' in the antidepressant trial summary ('of 11 antidepressant drugs'). Also seen before numbers after 'up to' and 'plus'.

modes.label: Space before trial counts
modes.description: A space before a number that counts drugs in the antidepressant pooled-trial summary.
modes.example: short-term trials (median duration of 2 months) of<< >>11 antidepressant drugs in over

modes.label: Space before duration or dose
modes.description: A space before a number giving a duration or a dose amount.
modes.example: continuation of response in clinical studies up to<< >>52 weeks, at the same dose

card.writes: It favors odd tokens such as 'auxiliary' and Chinese characters, and suppresses words meaning increase or reduce, so there is no clear output effect on the next number.
card.plain: It fires on the gap just before a number in sentences about trial size, length or dose.
